Frequently Asked Questions

GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst (max) currently leads AA-Image-Editing v2.0 with an Elo score of 1182.

The top models on AA-Image-Editing v2.0 by Elo rating are: 1. GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst (max) (Elo 1182), 2. GPT Image 2.5 Flare (max) (Elo 1162), 3. MAI-Image-2.6 (Elo 1137), 4. MAI-Image-2.6-Flash (Elo 1126), and 5. GPT Image 2 (high) (Elo 1122). Rankings are based on blind votes from our recruited human panel, together with public Image Arena votes cast before 1 January 2026.

Text to Image generation creates entirely new images from text descriptions, while image editing modifies existing images based on instructions. Image editing models take both an input image and editing instructions, then produce a modified version of the original image.

Models are ranked using an Elo rating system derived from blind comparisons judged by our recruited human panel, together with public Image Arena votes cast before 1 January 2026. Voters compare edited outputs from the same input image and editing instruction, choosing the result they prefer. Higher Elo scores indicate a model is preferred more often. Vote in the Artificial Analysis Image Arena

Qwen-Image-2.1 currently leads among open weights models on AA-Image-Editing v2.0 with an Elo score of 1073, followed by HunyuanImage 3.0 Instruct (Elo 1066) and Qwen Image Edit Plus 2511 (Elo 1021).
